summary: Backend (27 pytest cases) and frontend smoke testing for Otaku Hub. 26/27 backend tests pass (96%). Auth, titles, reviews, watchlist, friends, lobby/title/DM messages, DM 403 enforcement, and notifications all work. Frontend loads with RTL, admin login redirects to home with 6 seeded title cards, hero + nav (home/lobby/messages/friends/admin) all functional, lobby chat send works, admin panel renders add-title form.

minor.issue: Root endpoint returns 404 because @api.get('/') in server.py is defined AFTER app.include_router(api). Move route definition above include_router or it will never register. No impact on real features.

ui_bugs.issue: Page stayed on 'جار التحميل...' loading indicator after navigation; missing data-testid for add-watchlist, review-submit, discussion-tab, reviews-tab. Either page is slow / failing to fetch /api/titles/{id} or required testids were never added. Needs investigation.

action_items: Investigate TitleDetailPage: confirm it fetches /api/titles/{id} successfully and exits the loading state; add data-testid attributes: add-watchlist, review-submit, reviews-tab, discussion-tab so flows are testable.
Consider adding data-testid='chat-input' and 'chat-send' on ChatRoom (currently auto-detected via fallback selectors).
critical_code_review_comments: DM room id uses sorted UUIDs joined with '_' producing 'dm_<uuidA>_<uuidB>'. Splitting by '_' then comparing to user id works only because UUIDs themselves contain '-' not '_'; OK but fragile — prefer storing participants array.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for Bearer-token auth; acceptable.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (good). JWT 7-day expiry stored client-side in localStorage (acceptable per spec).
All MongoDB queries correctly project out _id. No ObjectId leakage.
/api/dm uses regex on room_id and string split — works but a participants index would scale better.
Per spec @app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@otaku.com / Admin@12345 (seeded). Tester accounts created dynamically per run with unique emails.
seed_data_creation: Admin user and 6 sample titles are auto-seeded by backend startup. Tests create transient TEST_ users/titles and admin-deletes its test title at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 26 listed endpoints + role/permission checks. The single failing test (test_root) is a code-ordering bug (route registered after router include). Frontend title-detail page needs testid attributes and verification that the title detail fetch + tabs (reviews/discussion) work end-to-end before claiming full UI pass.
